Phase 3 review (2026-04-15): exec-policy split deferred to Phase 4+. Candidates: 'No hardcoded secrets' (auto-detectable via regex pre-commit), 'Rate limiting on all endpoints' (runtime check). Non-candidates (guidance only): input validation patterns, SQL injection prevention, XSS/CSRF, auth/authz, error filtering, response protocol, remote session security.
policy-review-completed: 'No hardcoded secrets' → EX-009로 분리 (paired-direct / rules). 'Rate limiting'은 runtime check으로 guidance 유지. 나머지 6건은 guidance only 확정.

entries.detail: EX-007 (security) exec-policy split 결과. 'No hardcoded secrets' 정책은 Codex Rules (exec/approval policy)의 forbidden 카테고리에 자연 매핑. pre-commit regex 패턴으로 자동 감지 가능.
entries.reason: Codex Rules는 sandbox 밖 명령 실행 정책 제어용. 비밀 하드코딩 금지는 exec-policy (forbidden) 의미에 부합. AGENTS.md의 security 섹션은 guidance로 유지하되, 이 항목은 Codex Rules direct 후보로 분리.
docConstraints: Codex Rules format: allow/prompt/forbidden policy
